messages:
Anna (ML): heads-up — onboarding quant-v2 on 64k window: seeing token-level divergence when we stream long prompts with prefill + interleaved shard layout. repro attached below.
Miguel (Infra): can you paste the minimal repro? is this only with quantized weights?
Anna (ML): quick repro: run request with 40k prompt, then append ~4k stream tokens. With kv-prefill enabled we get correct outputs for first 20k, then a subtle drift (answer tokens mismatch) after ~24k. Happens only on int8 and int4 builds.
Sasha (Eval): observed something similar in yesterday's bench run but chalked it up to prompt truncation. Do you have diffs?
Anna (ML): snippet:
```bash
# run on devded node:
./serve_model --model /mnt/models/quant-v2 --prefill-mode=interleaved --kv-cache-size=65536 --streaming=true --batch=1
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d @long_request.json
```
long_request.json contains a 40k token article + 4k appended Q.
Priyanka (Quant): any chance rotary scaling code got different handling in quant pipeline? we recently landed a tiny refactor to apply RoPE clamps during packing.
Kevin (EngRuntime): pinging runtime logs: can you paste the server output around the divergence window? benchbot might have traces.
benchbot: attached trace id trace-2026-03-05-42 for that run; kv_index=24576..26112 around time of mismatch.
Anna (ML): logs:
```
[2026-03-05T18:12:04Z] priming done prefix_len=40960 kv_slots=65536
[2026-03-05T18:12:45Z] streaming token 24001 idx=24000 kv_write=24000
[2026-03-05T18:13:01Z] generated token mismatch expected='the user said' got='the user said,'
[2026-03-05T18:13:01Z] kv_read_index=24000 kv_offset=128 internal-rope-phase=0.9993
```
Miguel (Infra): interesting kv_offset changed around that point. Could be a wrap vs shadowing bug when interleaved shards flush older slots.
Priyanka (Quant): if RoPE clamp uses float path vs int path there could be a rounding swing that accumulates on repeats. But a single punctuation comma seems tiny — why accumulate?
Sasha (Eval): small punctuation diffs can cascade for autoregressive models; tiny logit deltas early can flip tokens later. We should do token-level logit diffs between float32 baseline and quant runs.
Kevin (EngRuntime): action items: 1) reproduce with deterministic seed and export logits at token 23990..24020 on both float and quant. 2) run with prefill-mode=sequential to see if interleaving is the factor. 3) enable kv-debug to dump indices.
Anna (ML): I'll run deterministic pass and upload logs. Setting up a short script now.
Anna (ML): quick note — when I forced prefill-mode=sequential the mismatch didn't show up in 3/3 runs. Interleaved appears to correlate.
Priyanka (Quant): that strongly points at write ordering vs packing. I'll review the clamp/refactor commit and run int4 emulation on cpu to see if packing order changes float rounding.
Miguel (Infra): I'll check shard eviction heuristics and whether flush + compact can reorder writes across shards under heavy prefill.
Sasha (Eval): I'll prepare a small bench that captures prefix logits and computes KL/emd drift across the long span, plus pass/fail criteria for rollout.
Kevin (EngRuntime): if we confirm ordering bug, we should gate interleaved prefill on quant models until fixed and add a canary config.
Anna (ML): thanks — uploading deterministic traces to GCS: gs://redwood-dev/trace-1719998888.zip (contains logits, kv-dump, run.sh).
benchbot: CI note: created issue #MM-472-prefill-shadowing with tags [kv-cache][quant][roper-scale] and linked trace.
Miguel (Infra): assigning to @Kevin and @Priyanka for initial investigation.
Kevin (EngRuntime): ack. I'll start with runtime diffs and re-run with kv-debug.
Priyanka (Quant): ack. I'll bisect the quant refactor and run pack-order simulations.
Sasha (Eval): leaving a quick eval checklist in the issue: token-diff heatmap, KL window, deterministic seeds, sequential vs interleaved.
Anna (ML): if anyone reproduces a minimal 500-token repro I can use it to draft a regression test. For now tagging this as P1 for model bring-up. :rotating_light:
